knowledge:
- key_parameters: teststatistics=Vector or matrix of z-scores ;; effectsizes=Matrix of effect sizes (used when test-statistics are not directly provided) ;; standarderrors=Matrix of standard errors (used alongside effect sizes) ;; burnin=Logical value indicating whether to plot the burn-in period in traces (default is TRUE) ;; n=Number of Gibbs sampling iterations to plot in the fit function ;; index=Integer index specifying which study/set to plot when multiple sets are analyzed ;; type=Type of plot to generate, either "hist" (histogram of z-scores) or "qq" (quantile-quantile plot of -log10 p-values) ;; globalSeed=Seed for random number generation in the Gibbs sampler (set to NULL for parallel processes) ;; parallelSeed=Seed used by BiocParallel to control RNG across parallel processes (default is 42)
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing association statistics (z-scores, effect sizes, and standard errors) from epigenome-wide (EWAS) or transcriptome-wide (TWAS) association studies that exhibit inflation and bias, or when performing fixed-effect meta-analysis across multiple such cohorts.
- pitfalls: Forgetting to register a parallel backend using BiocParallel when analyzing multiple sets of test statistics, which will trigger a warning and fall back to serial execution. Using uncorrected p-values instead of the corrected ones extracted via the package's accessor functions. Not setting globalSeed to NULL when attempting to run parallelized RNG across multiple cores.

workflows.name: single_set_correction
workflows.intent: Correct bias and inflation for a single vector of association test statistics.
workflows.stages: 1. Run the Gibbs sampler to estimate the empirical null distribution using bacon ;; 2. Extract estimated parameters, inflation, and bias using estimates, inflation, and bias ;; 3. Diagnose the Gibbs sampler fit using traces, posteriors, and fit ;; 4. Plot diagnostic histogram and QQ-plots using plot.
workflows.code:
y <- rnormmix(5000, c(0.9, 0.2, 1.3, 1, 4, 1))
bc <- bacon(y)
bc
estimates(bc)
inflation(bc)
bias(bc)
traces(bc, burnin=FALSE)
posteriors(bc)
fit(bc, n=100)
plot(bc, type="hist")
plot(bc, type="qq")

workflows.name: multiple_sets_and_meta_analysis
workflows.intent: Correct bias and inflation across multiple cohorts and perform a fixed-effect meta-analysis.
workflows.stages: 1. Register a parallel backend using BiocParallel ;; 2. Run bacon on the effect sizes and standard errors ;; 3. Extract corrected statistics (t-statistics, p-values, standard errors, effect sizes) ;; 4. Diagnose individual cohort fits using traces, posteriors, and fit with the index parameter ;; 5. Perform fixed-effect meta-analysis using meta ;; 6. Extract top results using topTable and plot meta-analysis QQ-plots.
workflows.code:
set.seed(12345)
biases <- runif(6, -0.2, 0.2)
inflations <- runif(6, 1, 1.3)
es <- matrix(nrow=5000, ncol=6)
for(i in 1:6)
    es[,i] <- rnormmix(5000, c(0.9, biases[i], inflations[i], 0, 4, 1), shuffle=FALSE)
se <- replicate(6, 0.8*sqrt(4/rchisq(5000,df=4)))
colnames(es) <- colnames(se) <- LETTERS[1:ncol(se)]
rownames(es) <- rownames(se) <- 1:5000
head(rownames(es))
head(colnames(es))
library(BiocParallel)
register(MulticoreParam(1, log=TRUE))
bc <- bacon(NULL, es, se)
bc
estimates(bc)
inflation(bc)
bias(bc)
tstat(bc)[1:5,]
pval(bc)[1:5,]
se(bc)[1:5,]
es(bc)[1:5,]
traces(bc, burnin=FALSE, index=3)
posteriors(bc, index=3)
fit(bc, n=100, index=3)
plot(bc, type="hist")
plot(bc, type="qq")
bcm <- meta(bc)
head(pval(bcm))
print(topTable(bcm))
plot(bcm, type="qq")

workflows.name: adjustment_with_95_ci
workflows.intent: Calculate average inflation- and bias-adjusted statistics with a 95% confidence interval using replicated z-scores.
workflows.stages: 1. Replicate z-scores into a matrix ;; 2. Run bacon with parallel RNG enabled by setting globalSeed to NULL ;; 3. Calculate mean bias and inflation ;; 4. Calculate 95% confidence intervals using quantile ;; 5. Extract average corrected z-scores and p-values using rowMeans.
workflows.code:
zs <- rnormmix(5000, c(0.9, 0.2, 1.3, 1, 4, 1))
zs <- cbind(zs, matrix(zs, nrow=5000, ncol=9))
colnames(zs) <- c(paste0("A", 1:10))
rownames(zs) <- 1:5000
head(rownames(zs))
head(colnames(zs))
library(BiocParallel)
register(MulticoreParam(1, log=TRUE))
bc <- bacon(teststatistics = zs, 
            globalSeed = NULL,
            parallelSeed = 42)
bc
head(inflation(bc))
head(bias(bc))
mean_bias <- mean(bias(bc))
mean_bias
mean_inflation <- mean(inflation(bc))
mean_inflation
CI_bias <- quantile(bias(bc), c(0.025, 0.975))
CI_bias
CI_inflation <- quantile(inflation(bc), c(0.025, 0.975))
CI_inflation
avg_corrected_zs <- rowMeans(tstat(bc))
avg_corrected_zs[1:5]
avg_corrected_pvals <- rowMeans(bacon::pval(bc))
avg_corrected_pvals[1:5]
